senses.gloss: בֵּרוּרֵי המדות exact account of wine measures, whence, the surplus in the shopkeeper’s wine account arising from measuring quickly and not allowing the wine to settle in the measures.
units: Bets. III, 8 (29ᵃ) ed. (properly omitted in Ms. M., v. Rashi a. l.; Var. in Rashi Ms. בֵּרוּצֵי). Ib. 29ᵃ three hundred gereb (v. גרב) of wine מב׳ המ׳ from the surplus found in his account.
